Bulldozer Demolishes Homes and Shops in Uttar Pradesh

In Uttar Pradesh's Chitrakoot district, bulldozers were used to demolish over 20 homes and shops in the Bargad Mod to Railway Station area. Another report from Nakti village states that 80 homes were demolished, with an MLA assuring affected residents that they would be provided with housing. The demolitions have resulted in significant destruction, turning homes into rubble.
